name: EXM_CC_OUTSTND_TRXN_SUM
description: This table contains summarized aging information of outstanding corporate card transactions by company account, cost center, and business unit.

columns.name: SUMMARY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a summary record.

columns.name: CARD_PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the corporate card program associated with the summary information.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the business unit associated with the summary information.

columns.name: COST_CENTER
columns.description: Identifier of the cost center associated with the summary information.

columns.name: COMPANY_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the company account associated with the summary information.

columns.name: PENDING_ACTION
columns.description: Person with whom the expense report is pending action.

columns.name: AGING_BUCKET1_AMOUNT
columns.description: Outstanding corporate card transaction amount in the first age group.

columns.name: AGING_BUCKET2_AMOUNT
columns.description: Outstanding corporate card transaction amount in the second age group.

columns.name: AGING_BUCKET3_AMOUNT
columns.description: Outstanding corporate card transaction amount in the third age group.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code which is used to summarize the amounts

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
